data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ip -br addr
lo               UNKNOWN        127.0.0.1/8 ::1/128
eth0             UP             10.0.0.12/24 fe80::250:56ff:fe8c:3d1a/64

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ip route
default via 10.0.0.1 dev eth0 proto dhcp src 10.0.0.12 metric 100
10.0.0.0/24 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 10.0.0.12

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/resolv.conf
dynamic resolv.conf(5) file for glibc resolver(3) generated by resolvconf(8)
    DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE BY HAND -- YOUR CHANGES WILL BE OVERWRITTEN
nameserver 10.0.0.2
search corp.local

webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/hosts
127.0.0.1 localhost
127.0.1.1 web-srv-01

10.0.0.12 web-srv-01.corp.local web-srv-01

::1     ip6-localhost ip6-loopback
fe00::0 ip6-localnet
ff00::0 ip6-mcastprefix
ff02::1 ip6-allnodes
ff02::2 ip6-allrouters

web-srv-01.corp.local
